finding: The source stores floor(n*(rank+1)/ranks)-floor(n*rank/ranks) local rows, but selects pivot owner=floor(k*ranks/n). At n=513 with four ranks, pivots 128, 256 and 384 select the preceding rank, and local=k-start equals its local row count. The CUDA row download therefore reads past the logical local distance allocation and broadcasts an invalid pivot.
observed_failure: The exclusive hybrid run exits successfully and prints Validation: PASSED with matching sampled fields, but its complete integer distance matrix hashes to 34a28a3de3b42e0e rather than the reference 545fd518ecf0a47c.
interpretation: Pre-existing remainder-boundary ownership/out-of-bounds defect. The approved integer comparison detects an error hidden by the sparse samples. Retain failure without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exact integer comparison; no new program execution.
